corrections.embedding_usage_fields: Supersedes measurement.json: embedding output tokens are not_applicable and cached input tokens unavailable, not zero. All measured values and quality scores unchanged.
corrections.live_wrapper_inventory: Overrides incorrect offline-only metric statuses in ingest-run-1, answers-run-1 and repair-1/answers-run-1 and lifecycle-run-1; raw records preserved.
corrections.retrieval_diagnostics: retrieval-diagnostics-v2.json supersedes v1 per-query reranked values: v1 mistakenly read the prerank candidates rather than sorted matches. Final-selected metrics are unchanged.
corrections.source_review_preparation: Source extraction/rendering and freeze preparation commands predated the generic command wrapper. Original pages, extracted text and fixture hashes retained; exact preparation command duration unavailable. No paid call or performance claim attached.

validity.backend_test_contention: backend-tests-1 (26.74s pytest duration) overlapped early repair-pass requests. Latency changes cannot be attributed solely to product changes; no extra paid pass was run for cleaner timing.
validity.scope: OCR/visual/formula capabilities are deferred. No live browser was run this turn; original bytes/ranges/page counts/history/delete were verified via HTTP. Prior browser coverage is not represented as current browser evidence.
